setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer notes the whole Scarlet Begonias fits on one disc; Garcia takes three pleasant solos; the jam is mostly quiet, and he engages the wah around 11:40 for the Fire intro [17][18]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Phil plays powerful bass lines from mid-first set, peaking in a fine Samson [13]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Jerry plays all three solos blazing after catching the Fire intro following some noodling out of Scarlet [14]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Estimated jam one of the best ever heard, with the band pinning the needle [15]
- **Close Encounters** (1 other source): A Close Encounters tease occurs in Space [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Close Encounters**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-04-08.sbd.betty.wbotb.83404.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Dropout at 3:32 on disc 3 track 1 loses roughly 5-10 seconds of music [1]
- **gd1978-04-08.148006.sbd.betty.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1978-04-08.148615.mtx.seamons.ht118.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 177 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Twenty seconds of distortion or fluctuation in Eyes Of The World, present in the soundboard source and earlier transfers [3]
- **gd1978-04-08.150560.BettyBoard.Anon.Noel.t-flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 169 min [5]
- **gd78-04-08.sbd.lai.4144.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 154 min; rated 4.24/5 by 21 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard not the best sounding, though the second set is strong; Soundboard has a distant, arena-like quality, unlike typical Betty Boards; this helps the Estimated jam; Phil's bass is badly muted at the start of Scarlet, so the soundboard rates a four [14][15][18][22]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the whole band is on track and eager throughout the show [13]
- Attendee found the show lackluster, saying Jerry missed several cues; it was their last Dead show, though their first-time friend enjoyed it [19]
- Reviewer finds the show short, weak and full of miscues compared with others from 1978 [20]
- Reviewer thinks the show is underrated, with a mellow, laid-back vibe and a spacier-than-usual Jerry [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-04-08.sbd.betty.wbotb.83404.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Jace and Tim Diebert; source: 7" Betty Board Reel @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM501ES > Fostex D5 > optical S/PDIF out (Jace's tape) > disk [1]
- **gd1978-04-08.148006.sbd.betty.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor;Tim Dalton; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: Source: SBD Master Reel (7" two track @ 7 1/2 ips - recorded by Betty Cantor) > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz > DAT (44k) - From the Tim Dalton collection. [2]
- **gd1978-04-08.148615.mtx.seamons.ht118.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons [3]. Also: Matrix mix of soundboard with audience patches: a 1:30 audience cut in Samson, another during Drums, and one after Fire On The Mountain [3]
- **gd1978-04-08.150560.BettyBoard.Anon.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by PCM Source & Transfer by Anonymous Edited & Mastered by Joe Noel July 03, 2020; source: Betty Cantor’s Master SBD Reel > PCM > PCM [5]. Also: Betty Board transfer shared anonymously, patched with a source supplied by Charlie Miller; tape pauses were cross faded [5]
- **gd78-04-08.sbd.lai.4144.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by tela.sugarmegs.org: [Sugarmegs Audio Setlist](https://tela.sugarmegs.org/_asxtela/asxcards/gd1978-04-08sbdVeteransMemorialColiseumJacksonvilleFL.html) [26]
